summary: Evidence-backed updates for AI Evaluation Field Guide.

changes.text: Add controlled criterion/answer probes and rubric-only baselines.
changes.rationale: Add two observable probes to Module 8: criterion-only baseline and answer/criterion reversals, alongside existing order and style probes.

changes.text: Pair credential attacks with legitimate controls and test persistent-memory risk slices.
changes.rationale: Add paired legitimate/phishing cases and stale/conflicting/cross-user/revoked-memory slices to the threat-driven agent checklist; grade submissions and task completion separately.

changes.text: Measure surface coverage, unflagged-traffic audits and alert-to-response performance.
changes.rationale: Add coverage accounting, negative-traffic audits and alert-to-response tests; report threat-specific recall and responder availability rather than one aggregate monitor score.

changes.text: Add prediction-time availability, paired known-failure controls and a provenance verifier.
changes.rationale: Extend leakage guidance beyond final-test reuse to prediction-time feature validity, paired known-failure controls and a deterministic provenance verifier, with the clinical preprint's limits explicit.
